full_page.content:
c. 1937
Page 4 Reb. Edward F. Casey
Well Dear Edward; you are no doubt surprized at the length of this letter. I hope it is grave enough not to scandalize. I hardly need say I finished it Sunday night after starting as the clock struck il. I pro- bably had not finished and it would have gone as so many others, and I behaved myself a little better, physically, and not been sent ... a cell recuperating. Just a little cold Thank God. I'm posted for the 5 o'clock Mass tomorrow ( Ist Sunday of Lent) So I'll just say
Good Night and God Bless You and yours. Fr. Solanus ..
